string-array.item: Chain merges on back-to-back swipes to build a combo multiplier up to ×4.
Blockers crumble on their own after 10 moves — or smash them with the hammer.
A bomb never merges. Move it away or it clears a 3×3 area when the fuse hits 0.
Out of room? The Mega Bomb wipes a whole 3×3 area — including traps.
Stuck? Shuffle re-scatters the board; Undo takes back your last move.
Empty boosters can be refilled instantly by watching a short ad.

resources.string: Merge Blocks needs an internet connection to play. Please reconnect and try again.
Haptic feedback on merges and blasts

Swipe to slide all tiles. When two tiles with the same number touch, they merge into one worth double. Fill the board with no moves left and it\'s game over.\n\nMerge on consecutive swipes to stack a COMBO multiplier (up to ×4) for bonus points.
🔒 Blocker — an immovable stone that splits the board. It crumbles after 10 moves.\n\n💣 Bomb — slides but never merges. Its fuse ticks down each move; at 0 it explodes a 3×3 area.

↩ Undo — take back your last action.
🔨 Hammer — tap any single tile to smash it.
🔀 Shuffle — re-scatter every movable tile.
💥 Mega Bomb — tap to blow up a whole 3×3 area, traps included.

Run out? Watch a short ad to refill.
